items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Barry Harris is with you on here. ... Yeah, that was a duo, but with a rhythm section.

ctx.x: Again with a trio. Then 1991, Confirmation. Barry Harris is with you on here.
Barry Harris. Yeah, that was a duo, but with a rhythm section.

Then another – boy, you’re working these trios. ’91, The Moment, Victor Lewis and Rufus Reid, Reservoir again. Then, here’s one, 1991, Quickstep. This, oh yeah. I think I might have seen the group. John Stubblefield. I don’t know if I saw this group, but man, John Stubblefield, Eddie Henderson, David Williams, and Victor Lewis.
